meta.name: prioritization-advisor
meta.description: Choose a prioritization framework based on stage, team context, and stakeholder needs. Use when deciding between RICE, ICE, value/effort, or another scoring approach.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据阶段和团队情况选出最佳优先级方法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在多个需求间犹豫选择哪个优先做
copy.tagline_en: Pick the best prioritization method based on stage and team context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to choose which feature to work on next

howto.what: Claude 会通过询问产品阶段、团队环境、决策需求和数据情况，推荐一个适合的优先级框架（如 RICE、ICE、价值/努力矩阵等），并给出实施步骤和注意事项。它不是打分计算器，而是匹配框架的决策指南。
howto.when: 当用户需要选择优先级框架、比较不同框架（如 RICE、ICE 等）、或团队对优先级方法有争议时触发。

say.text: 我的创业公司应该用哪个优先级框架？
say.note: Claude 会开始提问并推荐框架。

say.text: 帮我选择 RICE 和价值/努力矩阵来做路线规划。
say.note: Claude 会针对这两个框架进行适配评估。

say.text: 我们团队总是在优先级上争论不休，推荐一个框架。
say.note: Claude 会询问具体背景后给出建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will ask about product stage, team context, decision-making needs, and data availability, then recommend a suitable prioritization framework (e.g., RICE, ICE, value/effort matrix) with implementation steps and limitations. It is a decision guide, not a scoring calculator.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for help choosing a prioritization framework, compares frameworks like RICE or ICE, or when the team has conflicts over prioritization methods.

say_en.text: Which prioritization framework should my startup use right now?
say_en.note: Claude will ask questions and recommend.

say_en.text: Help me choose between RICE and value/effort for roadmap planning.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate both frameworks for your context.

say_en.text: We keep arguing about prioritization. Recommend a framework.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about your situation and suggest one.
